title: mmWave Radar
summary: See people move: a viewer for the Hi-Link LD2452 and LD2451 radars.
description: Shows up to three targets the radar tracks: a top-down plot with trails and speed arrows, a table of the raw numbers, a 30 s graph of distance and speed, and the sensor's state. For the HLK-LD2452 (and LD2450) and the HLK-LD2451, on a USB-serial adapter, or the LD2451 over Bluetooth LE. Listen only: it sends nothing to the sensor. Needs a screen of at least 480x320 (portrait 320x480 in PDA mode).
